name: chat-with-pdf-workspace
description: Workspace for the Angular frontend and Express backend of Chat with PDF

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm --prefix backend run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm --prefix frontend run start
scripts.build: node init && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: node init && npm --prefix backend run start
scripts.start:prod: node init && npm run build && npm start
